summary: The boundary and wayfinding failures are construction defects, not merely a lack of decorative detail. The exact A08 flicker cause is a retained roof cap sharing the ceiling plane; two exterior seams are physically unblocked; two identification systems are incorrectly placed or oriented.

findings.title: A08 and cafe approach ceilings are coplanar with retained roof caps
evidence: SourceInventory38: SM_AP_Room37_gate08foyer Fitted acoustic room ceiling35.020 has bottom z3.4, XY[-31.99,-24.01]x[14.01,17.99].
SourceInventory38: SM_AP_Roof35 Weather-sealed roof cap35.003 has bottom z3.4, XY[-32.075001,-23.924999]x[13.925,18.075001].
The same exact coincidence exists for cafefoyer: Room37 ceiling bottom3.4, Roof35 cap35.002 bottom3.4.
AuditInventory38: Crafted Roof35 is visible=true, hidden=false. model37 repositions ceilings from3.3 to3.4 but retains Roof35 built from height3.3.
findings.correction: Give room ceilings and weather roof caps one coherent owner. Rebuild cap heights from current zone heights with positive vertical separation; remove obsolete hidden underside faces where redundant. Do not add another ceiling cover on top.
findings.acceptance: Static-camera hold and walking capture through both approaches show no alternating ceiling pixels/edges; assert no coincident upward/downward planar face pair across visible ceiling footprint.

findings.title: Amenities have a real east-envelope opening into the exterior
evidence: model37 skips all east-boundary x=-14 segments with y-high<=10, then only restores gate07 y=-3..10.
Last legacy east facade centre y=-6.25, length3.5: it ends at y=-4.5. Restored east gate wall starts y=-3.0, leaving1.5m unsealed.
BaselineCapture38 trace WC east breach returns blocking=false, mesh=null.
findings.correction: Build a continuous exterior envelope covering amenities and arrivals from current zone bounds and subtract only named doors/windows with deliberate collision. Seal the1.5m northeast amenities gap with a full-height constructed wall.
findings.acceptance: Ray and swept player capsule at (-15,-3.8,1.0) toward(-12,-3.8,1.0) are blocked; walk-test the whole WC perimeter and all adjacent envelope seams.

findings.title: Security entry has an unsealed west facade-to-wall seam
evidence: Legacy west facade centre y=-6.25 spans -8..-4.5, while the security west wall begins at y=-4.
model37 deliberately skips west-boundary segments with y-high<=-4 and relies on those remnants.
BaselineCapture38 trace Security west breach returns blocking=false, mesh=null; 06_WestEntryGap shows the disconnected end condition.
findings.correction: Join the landside/security envelope as one continuous wall/glazing system; provide a proper jamb/cap at the glazing end and continuous collision.
findings.acceptance: Perimeter rays at several heights and capsule sweeps across x=-49,y=-4.5..-4 are blocked; there is no visual crack or walkable slot.

findings.title: STAFF ONLY board is hung across the usable door aperture
evidence: Native Staff service leaf24 occupies x[-46.5,-45.5],y[9.852128,10.06],z[0,2.7].
Native Sign24_1816 occupies x[-46.874,-45.126],y[9.751,9.949],z[2.0225,2.4775]. It crosses the opening rather than mounting above or beside it.
BaselineScreenshots/10_StaffDoor.png clearly shows the wide sign spanning the doorway below its header.
findings.correction: Place a smaller staff plaque on the solid wall beside the door or above the clear header, with physical mounting. Keep the full doorway clear.
findings.acceptance: Door opening and sign bounds do not overlap at any door state. Standing/seated-eye photographs show an intentional attached plaque and unobstructed head clearance.

findings.title: WC identification floats inside the opening and faces away from approaching players
evidence: Identity37 WC backing bounds x[-26.24,-26.120001],y[-3.325,-2.675],z[1.525,2.375]. The concourse->amenitylobby portal is centred(-26,-3), width1.8.
WC and TOILETS fonts are at x=-26.105, rotation(pi/2,0,+pi/2), normal+X. Players approach from concourse x<-26, requiring normal-X. Text is behind the backing from that side.
BaselineScreenshots/18_WCSign.png shows the plain blue back of a visibly unsupported board in the doorway.
findings.correction: Mount the sign to an actual solid wall beside the opening or make an attached, two-sided blade. Orient readable faces to the approach, place fonts on the correct outward face, and add a clear toilet pictogram.
findings.acceptance: From (-28.2,-2.2,1.62), identification is readable, properly backed and outside the opening. No part floats or obstructs the passage; verify both approach directions.

findings.title: The A08 marker is hidden behind its own entrance landscaping
evidence: BaselineScreenshots/14_A08Marker.png shows the plant obscuring the marker almost completely. The normal south approach crosses that canopy silhouette.
findings.correction: Move the identification above or clearly beside the opening at an approach-readable height and move both planters away from the sign/door sightlines.
findings.acceptance: From the concourse approach, both standing and moving views show the complete A08 identifier without foliage overlap; include a visibility trace to its sign face.

findings.title: A08 threshold is a leftover pocket rather than a coherent entrance
evidence: Concourse rect[-32,-26,-4,14] expands abruptly into gate08foyer rect[-32,-24,14,18]; the extra eastern2m strip becomes a blind side pocket instead of a useful destination.
South portal centrex=-29,width4.4 (x[-31.2,-26.8]); north portal centrex=-28,width4.6 (x[-30.3,-25.7]). Two shifted openings and two planters frame a4m-deep intermediate box.
Plant1224_1771 canopy reaches x=-23.982853 while the west face of the east wall is approximatelyx=-24.09, so foliage penetrates the wall by roughly0.11m.
The decorative sage post/frame sits immediately in front of the structural jamb/header, adding a second competing entrance outline.
findings.correction: Redesign the A08 threshold as one purposeful pause/turn with a clearly dimensioned clear route and one integrated entrance construction. Reconcile the2m return with the main concourse rather than using an arbitrary dead pocket. Move planters inside safe perimeter positions.
findings.acceptance: A floor-plan overlay shows no unexplained dead cubby; no planter intersects wall bounds; the entrance has one deliberate jamb/header system and a visible A08 identity from the decision point.

findings.title: The narrow stacked directory is a weak primary wayfinding device
evidence: Identity37 directory body is only0.46m wide at(-31.25,9.8); individual labels use0.072m font size and cap-height about0.05m.
It faces south while the key recovery approach moves east, so it is small and oblique from the main decision view.
The literal >,<,^,v text provides weak directional hierarchy; the user explicitly rejected it. It competes with floor stripes and separate entrance identifiers instead of giving one clear decision.
objects: A07 > / CAFE < / A08 ^ / WC v fonts
findings.correction: Replace the free-standing stack with a properly mounted directory at the decision point, using larger primary destination names, recognizable pictograms and consistent arrows. Keep each entrance individually identifiable rather than restoring a row of identical banners.
findings.acceptance: At each decision viewpoint, the player can identify the gate/cafe/toilets without approaching to read tiny labels; arrows correspond to actual branch geometry, and no plant/prop occludes the primary information.

findings.title: Long generic circulation spaces still read as repeated empty boxes
evidence: The main concourse is6m x18m, recovery4m x10m, and both gate foyer/cafe foyer boxes use nearly identical cream/navy wall treatments with simple cut-out openings.
Baseline 12_Repacking,13_Concourse and Clarity37 01_ExitSightline show extensive blank planes and repeated rectangular framing. Removing glass reduced layers but did not resolve spatial hierarchy.
The A08 side pocket and the existing A07 dogleg are assembled from independent room rectangles rather than one coordinated circulation plan.
findings.correction: Resolve circulation as a connected architectural plan with purposeful transitions, wall returns, coherent ceiling ownership and a few readable landmarks. Do not fill empty floor with more random objects. Preserve usable room clearances.
findings.acceptance: A new walk-through shows clear choices and distinct destination thresholds without arbitrary unused pockets, repeated mini-rooms or walls that exist only to patch another rectangle.

findings.title: Previous passing checks did not audit the whole map or its construction
evidence: Clarity37 QA starts after check-in with one setup teleport, walks a selected waypoint route, tests seating/boarding and only two sightline traces.
It does not test every perimeter, door/sign bounds, the actual outward WC boundary, the security facade seam or multi-frame ceiling stability.
The current baseline has both live perimeter traces false despite the earlier93 checks passing.
findings.correction: Add a defect-driven acceptance matrix and boundary sweeps for every zone and doorway, plus moving-camera evidence. Keep route success separate from visual/construction sign-off.
findings.acceptance: Every finding has a named before/after proof. Whole-map sign-off requires all envelope seams, door clearances, object attachments and moving-image stability checks, not a higher count of waypoint assertions.

coverage.checkin: Boundary/portal plan reviewed; approved room layout retained. Equipment and baggage handling defects are referred to equipment reviewer rather than inferred here.
coverage.publicreturn: Rectangular boundary/portal continuity reviewed. Existing southern facade/ceiling system is retained; wider envelope acceptance must include this route (L10).
coverage.landsidecorridor: Source/native reviewed; old west glazing ends short of security wall (L03).
coverage.security: Entry boundary omission and staff doorway sign obstruction verified (L03,L04).
coverage.concourse: Directory and WC identification defects verified (L05,L08); spatial hierarchy remains weak (L09).
coverage.gate07foyer: Final ceiling footprint matches current zone; avoid diagnosing it as the remaining A08 flicker. A07 entrance remains a dogleg with explicit direction sign (L09).
coverage.gate07: Room enclosure footprint reviewed; desks/bridge handled by other reviewers. Clear opening is3m.
coverage.gate08foyer: Exact roof/ceiling coincidence, hidden marker and dead-pocket design verified (L01,L06,L07).
coverage.gate08: Room footprint matches current zone; passage sign/threshold failures are at its approach, not the back lounge ceiling (L01,L06,L07).
coverage.cafe: Existing room bounds and gallery access retained; visual equipment audit delegated. No broad current room-footprint mismatch found.
coverage.amenitylobby: Floating/back-facing WC identifier at its entrance (L05).
coverage.amenities: East envelope breach verified by source and live trace (L02).
coverage.arrivals: East boundary relies on legacy facade modules; covered current modules aty-22..-12, but include in continuous-envelope repair/validation (L02,L10).
coverage.operations: Access sign crosses the door opening (L04); storage detail handled by equipment reviewer.

suspected: Additional envelope gaps or coplanar faces outside this reviewed set remain possible; do not call every inherited piece defective without testing.
